# simplix-react · Package-first React Framework

> Define once. Derive everything.

simplix-react is a package-first React framework that auto-generates reusable domain packages from OpenAPI specs. Define your API surface once with Zod schemas, and the framework derives type-safe HTTP clients, React Query hooks, form hooks, and MSW mock handlers from it.

The documentation is written in English under `docs/en/` and in Korean under `docs/ko/`, with the same file names. This file lists the English documents.

## Docs

### Getting Started
- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/docs/en/getting-started/overview.md): What simplix-react is and how one contract derives every layer
- [Installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/docs/en/getting-started/installation.md): Prerequisites, packages and peer dependencies
- [Quick Start](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/docs/en/getting-started/quick-start.md): Contract, hooks, component and mock backend in one walkthrough
- [TypeScript Setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/docs/en/getting-started/typescript.md): Recommended tsconfig and Zod type inference

- [Authorization](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/docs/en/core-concepts/authorization.md): CASL-based RBAC and ABAC access control
- [Form Derivation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/docs/en/core-concepts/form-derivation.md): Form hooks derived from contracts
- [UI Components](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/docs/en/core-concepts/ui-components.md): CRUD UI component architecture
- [Internationalization](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/docs/en/core-concepts/internationalization.md): i18n framework architecture
- [Extensions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/docs/en/core-concepts/extensions.md): Extension system for backend-specific adapters

### Package References
- [@simplix-react-native-ext/capture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/extensions/native/packages/capture/README.md): Auto-capture session for simplix-react-native: camera preview, on-device face detection seam, composition judgement, countdown, retake, upload part
- [@simplix-react-native-ext/kiosk](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/extensions/native/packages/kiosk/README.md): Kiosk device control for simplix-react-native: keep-awake, Android Lock Task Mode, idle reset timer, network recovery screen
- [simplix-react-native](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/extensions/native/packages/meta/README.md): Meta package that installs the @simplix-react-native/* core packages (ui, runtime) in one dependency
- [@simplix-react-native-ext/qr](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/extensions/native/packages/qr/README.md): QR display for simplix-react-native: static QR rendering and rotating presence-token QR with remaining-validity display
- [@simplix-react-native/runtime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/extensions/native/packages/runtime/README.md): Expo runtime glue for simplix-react-native: secure token store adapters, Boot mutator assembly, app boot (error dialog, i18n registration, msw/native wiring)
- [@simplix-react-native-ext/signature](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/extensions/native/packages/signature/README.md): Drawn / typed signature capture for simplix-react-native, exported as PNG for upload (same payload contract as the web SignaturePad)
- [@simplix-react-native/ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/extensions/native/packages/ui/README.md): Standard mobile UI kit for simplix-react on React Native: layout primitives, page skeletons, controls, sheet-first overlays, FormFields / DetailFields, EntityList + useEntityFeed, theme token sheet
- [@simplix-react-ext/simplix-boot-access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/extensions/simplix-boot/packages/access/README.md): Spring Security authorization for @simplix-react/access: the permissions adapter and the self access policy
- [@simplix-react-ext/simplix-boot-auth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/extensions/simplix-boot/packages/auth/README.md): Spring Security authentication for simplix-boot
- [@simplix-react-ext/simplix-boot-cli-plugin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/extensions/simplix-boot/packages/cli-plugin/README.md): CLI plugin for simplix-boot OpenAPI spec profile
- [@simplix-react-ext/simplix-boot-stream](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/extensions/simplix-boot/packages/stream/README.md): SimpliX Boot SSE streaming infrastructure with EventSource management, subscriptions, and staleness detection
- [@simplix-react-ext/simplix-boot-utils](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/extensions/simplix-boot/packages/utils/README.md): Utility functions for simplix-boot
- [@simplix-react/access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/access/README.md): Authorization and access control for @simplix-react with CASL integration
- [@simplix-react/api](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/api/README.md): Orval mutator singleton for simplix-react domain packages
- [@simplix-react/auth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/auth/README.md): Authentication middleware for @simplix-react/contract with strategy pattern
- [@simplix-react/calendar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/calendar/README.md): Domain-agnostic calendar components (month/week/day/year/agenda/gantt/timeline/heatmap views) with pluggable rendering and interaction callbacks
- [@simplix-react/cli](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/cli/README.md): CLI for scaffolding and validating simplix-react projects
- [@simplix-react/contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/contract/README.md): Define type-safe API contracts with Zod schemas
- [@simplix-react/form](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/form/README.md): TanStack Form hooks derived from @simplix-react/contract schemas
- [@simplix-react/gantt-core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/gantt-core/README.md): Framework-free project scheduling engine: working calendars, dependency and constraint scheduling, critical path, baselines, resources and leveling, undo history, MS Project XML interchange
- [@simplix-react/gantt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/gantt/README.md): Project Gantt chart for React: task table with inline editing, timeline with drag scheduling and dependency links, critical path, baselines, resource sheet and usage, undo, MS Project XML interchange
- [@simplix-react/headless](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/headless/README.md): Platform-neutral headless logic shared by the web and native UI kits: Orval adapters, searchable filter serialization, toast store, formatting and date utilities, theme registry
- [@simplix-react/i18n](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/i18n/README.md): Internationalization framework with i18next adapter
- [@simplix-react/mock](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/mock/README.md): Auto-generated MSW handlers and in-memory stores from @simplix-react/contract
- [@simplix-react/process-core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/process-core/README.md): Framework-free procedure model: definition format, validation, condition evaluation, reading order, lane and stacked layout, editing operations with undo, version comparison
- [@simplix-react/process](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/process/README.md): Procedure lanes for React: steps and acts on a grid of lanes with jumps, parallel runs and conditions, laid out as one column on a narrow container
- [@simplix-react/react](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/react/README.md): React Query hooks derived from @simplix-react/contract
- [simplix-react-ext](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/simplix-react-ext/README.md): Meta package that installs all @simplix-react-ext/* extension packages (simplix-boot) in one dependency
- [simplix-react](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/simplix-react/README.md): Package-first React framework that auto-generates reusable domain packages from OpenAPI specs
- [@simplix-react/testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/testing/README.md): Testing utilities for simplix-react applications
- [@simplix-react/ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simplix-framework/simplix-react/main/packages/ui/README.md): CRUD scaffolding UI components with explicit field components and compound patterns
